source: Fingrid Open Data API (CC BY 4.0): day-ahead forecasts of wind (246) and consumption (165), measured wind (75) and consumption (124)
method: adaptive: split conformal prediction on Fingrid's own recent errors, grouped by six-hour block and forecast-level tercile (Mondrian), with adaptive conformal inference (gamma 0.05) correcting the miss rate day by day. Each day is calibrated on the 90 days ending two days before it, i.e. only on errors known when Fingrid issues its forecast.

methods_explained.global: one set of quantiles from all recent errors
methods_explained.by_hour: quantiles per six-hour block of the Finnish day
methods_explained.mondrian: quantiles per six-hour block and forecast-level tercile
methods_explained.adaptive: mondrian, with the target miss rate adjusted after every known day (published)
